detailed_description: Invoice Template Generator helps you prepare an invoice preview with three built-in styles: modern, classic, and minimal. Enter company and client details, dates, currency, line items, tax rate, and notes, then review the live invoice preview. The download button saves the rendered invoice as a standalone HTML file. It does not add logos, generate PDFs, send invoices, store recurring invoices, or connect to payment or accounting systems.
usage_steps: Choose modern, classic, or minimal style
Enter company, client, invoice date, due date, and currency details
Add line items with description, quantity, and unit price
Set the tax rate and optional notes
Review the live preview and download the invoice as HTML
usage_examples: Create a simple HTML invoice draft for a freelance project
Compare modern, classic, and minimal invoice layouts
Prepare an invoice preview with line items, tax, and notes
